description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Whizzing Edge
sections.description_summary: Passive: Sinbad's skills also deal normal-attack damage; casting speed uses ATK SPD and Haste. Active cast attacks one enemy repeatedly for 3 s, then lands a final strike.

sections.name: Tracker's Instincts
sections.description_summary: Six seconds into battle, marks the highest-damage enemy as hitter and the highest-damage-taken enemy as guard. Hits both and reduces hitter ATK while increasing guard damage taken. Reassesses when marks expire or a marked enemy is defeated.

sections.name: Duo Cut
sections.description_summary: Performs two melee strikes.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Adaptive Prowess
sections.description_summary: Adapts debuffs to the marked enemies' damage profile: reduces hitter ATK SPD or Energy Recovery efficiency; reduces guard Vitality or Phys/Magic DEF depending on their sustain profile.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Duo Cut deals extra damage to enemies marked as hitter or guard.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Deathmark Arrow
sections.description_summary: Fires magic arrows twice at each enemy; deals more damage and stuns enemies affected by Aging.

sections.name: Decay's Reach
sections.description_summary: At battle start applies Aging to the rearmost enemy, dealing damage and reducing Haste until battle ends. Bonnie prioritizes that target; allied magic damage can further reduce its Haste.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK.

sections.name: Blight Surge
sections.description_summary: When Aging reaches max stacks or an Aged enemy is defeated, spreads Aging to nearby unafflicted enemies.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Max-stack Aging increases magic damage taken, with an extra increase for Ultimate magic damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK per enemy affected by the caster's continuous-damage effects; higher ranks also reduce target Phys/Magic DEF.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Twirling Rocks
sections.description_summary: Rolls to a target tile, damages adjacent enemies and enters Combat Stance for the rest of battle. In this stance, consumes Energy for Vigorous Slam. When damaged by adjacent enemies, prioritizes Swift Evasion, dealing damage and slowing movement, then rolls away and gains a shield; once per 7 s.

sections.name: Stone Barrier
sections.description_summary: Blasts the nearest enemy, stuns them and creates earth pillars behind the target, knocking enemies back.

sections.name: Rolling Boulder
sections.description_summary: Targets enemies recently affected by control effects and drops boulders on them.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste, with extra Haste after entering Combat Stance.

sections.name: Don of Terra
sections.description_summary: Vigorous Slam damage and Swift Evasion shield values stack after use.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Rolling Boulder deals extra damage to enemies recently affected by multiple control effects. LV 2 adds a large boulder and Magic DEF reduction after enough targets have triggered it.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Alsa's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Storm's Wrath
sections.description_summary: Marene becomes invincible while summoning a 4 s storm, immediately damages all enemies based on their HP, repeatedly knocks all enemies airborne, reduces Ranged DEF and triggers Tempest Eye lightning strikes. Strike frequency scales with Haste, capped at 8 activations/sec.

sections.name: Gathering Gale
sections.description_summary: Passive amplifies allied Haste buffs received by Marene and retains the Haste after those buffs expire. Active cast channels Tempest Eye, generating gusts at enemy positions; activation frequency scales with Haste.

sections.name: Twin Cyclone
sections.description_summary: Launches two wind-blade clusters at the nearest and farthest enemies, repeatedly damaging targets and nearby enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; each Tempest Eye activation adds more ATK, stacking up to 30 times.

sections.name: Aeon Tempest
sections.description_summary: At sufficient allied Haste, Marene enters Windborne state with steadfast and defensive/offensive benefits. After 30 Tempest Eye activations, creates a permanent battlefield-wide thunderstorm; LV 4 can sweep eligible low-HP enemies off the battlefield, counting them as defeated.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Gusts and wind blades add true damage, stun and permanently reduce Vitality, stacking up to 15 times.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening damage and Haste; higher ranks restore HP and extend the effect after assists/defeats.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Forced Game
sections.description_summary: Non-summoned enemies roll individually. Different allies applying stat-reduction effects add Woe stacks, reducing the roll. Enemies that lose surrender ATK and max HP to Eryndor and take repeated damage. Stat gains have caps.

sections.name: Unfurling Blades
sections.description_summary: Attacks non-summoned enemies in order from lowest to highest HP ratio; Woe stacks increase damage taken from this skill.

sections.name: Veiled Return
sections.description_summary: Throws a fan into the densest enemy area and grants a shield; the fan repeatedly damages enemies. Returning fan grants an additional shield based on actual damage dealt.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; grants extra Haste when an enemy loses Eryndor's game.

sections.name: All is Lost
sections.description_summary: Ultimate gains extra hits against enemies who lose the game; repeated losses add extra hits. LV 3 permanently strips all stat buffs from qualifying non-boss enemies and reduces their ATK.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: At battle start collects a percentage of each non-summoned enemy's basic stats, subject to caps.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Under a stationary-tile condition, after 3 s increases damage and Haste; higher ranks add shield/steadfast.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Celestial Spirit Summon
sections.description_summary: Calls Aquarius, whose inherited stats and recurring water swirl damage, stun and knock airborne enemies in the densest tile area.

sections.name: Lucy Kick
sections.description_summary: Targets the enemy with the highest cumulative damage, damages and stuns them; Lucy is unaffected while using it.

sections.name: Star Dress: Aquarius Form
sections.description_summary: Ultimate transforms Lucy into Aquarius form for the rest of battle, repeating the water-swirl attack and extending her attack range.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Water Barrier
sections.description_summary: Aquarius/Lucy shields the weakest ally.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When Lucy reaches full Energy while Aquarius is present, Aquarius gains ATK SPD.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Divine Quake
sections.description_summary: Directional Rock Wave damages and pushes enemies to the battlefield edge, followed by a charge strike and stun. Damage increases with each surviving ally besides Scarlita.

sections.name: Sanctified Verdict
sections.description_summary: Opening blink to the backline and ascent grants invulnerability, Energy recovery and accumulating ATK. After 15 s or when ally count is low, descends near the frontmost enemy with AOE damage, airborne and stun.

sections.name: Valkyrie Spirit
sections.description_summary: While airborne, shields the weakest non-summoned ally. After descent, axe strikes damage and knock down enemies; damage scales with surviving allies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Execution increases for each blessing sent while airborne.

sections.name: Divine Wrath
sections.description_summary: Deals true damage when enough non-summoned allies survive. Higher ranks knock eligible low-HP non-boss enemies off the battlefield and count them as defeated.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Valkyrie Spirit also increases protected ally Phys/Magic DEF. LV 2 adds an emergency shield if the ally drops below 20% HP while Scarlita is airborne; if unused, landing smash affects the whole battlefield with bonus damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases shield value and grants Phys/Magic DEF when shielding; higher ranks also heal based on shield value.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Grave Crescendo
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks mesmerize enemies for 8 s and reduce ATK. Defeated mesmerized enemies become spectral spectators. At 1000 Energy, Senea begins a performance with increased ATK SPD; normal attacks consume Energy and deal max-HP-based true damage plus max HP reduction.

sections.name: Melodic Cascade
sections.description_summary: Gains extra projectiles with normal attacks; temporary allied stat buffs add projectiles, up to five. Active cast replaces projectiles with two musical notes.

sections.name: Swell of Sorrow
sections.description_summary: Sends sound waves across the battlefield for three hits; spectral spectators restore Senea's Energy and HP.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK, with extra ATK when at least three spectators are present.

sections.name: Crimson Solo
sections.description_summary: Normal attacks during Grave Crescendo attract additional spectators. With enough spectators, the stage rises and Senea becomes steadfast; after a hit threshold, spectators throw true-damage roses. LV 3 grants spirit form after defeat during solo performance.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Attracts two spectral spectators at battle start.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Celestial Rise
sections.description_summary: Opening passive grants a shield and large temporary max HP that decays each second. Restoring Baelran to max HP triggers Celestial Form; while transformed, bonus max HP no longer decays and normal attacks hit an arc. Active cast deals true damage in a frontal arc and heals based on damage dealt.

sections.name: Sanctified Surge
sections.description_summary: Provides passive HP recovery; in Celestial Form, blade hits add max-HP-based true damage.

sections.name: Wrath Cleave
sections.description_summary: Knocks the target airborne, then slams a rectangular area, knocking enemies down.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste, with extra Haste on entering Celestial Form.

sections.name: Divine Dominance
sections.description_summary: Restores bonus max HP on Celestial Form; a second max-HP restoration triggers enhanced form, permanent unaffected status and battlefield tile strikes.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Divine Light bonus damage can reduce non-boss max HP, with caps; Bosses instead lose a small percentage of HP.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases shield value and grants Phys/Magic DEF when shielding; higher ranks also heal based on shield value.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Mutual Reflection
sections.description_summary: Based on the count of non-summoned allies/enemies, teleports Reinier and an enemy to another dimension for 10 s, or teleports only the enemy. If the target is steadfast/unaffected or is the only non-summoned enemy alive, deals higher damage instead. Prioritizes the healthiest non-summoned enemy.

sections.name: Dynamic Balance
sections.description_summary: At battle start swaps an adjacent ally with a symmetrically placed enemy. The ally restores HP based on damage dealt to that enemy, subject to a cap. The page includes explicit hex-pair tie-break rules.

sections.name: Golden Ratio
sections.description_summary: Repeated strikes interrupt and damage the healthiest enemy, then knock them airborne. Crossing the 61.8% HP threshold triggers HP/Energy recovery; LV 4 also grants recovery to all allies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Dynamic Balance increases target ATK when cast on an ally or reduces it when cast on an enemy.

sections.name: Tuned Art
sections.description_summary: Dynamic Balance also damages and knocks down the enemy and increases their damage taken for the rest of battle.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Hex-pair targeting tie-breaks
sections.description_summary: The page includes explicit hex-pair tie-break rules for Dynamic Balance target selection; retained as separate targeting metadata.

capture_status_notes: Capture did not expose Enhance Force or Season Charm; verify whether they are absent or outside the returned excerpt.
